climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A geographical indication in the Canterbury region of New Zealand's South Island. Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir lead at 30% and 28% of the vines. Riesling is a strong third at 18%, followed by Pinot Gris.
